name: Channel Infrastructure NZ Limited
summary: Channel Infrastructure NZ Limited and its subsidiaries provide fuel and energy infrastructure in New Zealand, including the import terminal at Marsden Point with its jetty and storage tanks, the pipeline from Marsden Point to Auckland, the Somerton pipeline, and leasing and fuel testing laboratory services. Formerly The New Zealand Refining Company Limited, it was incorporated in 1961 and has its base in Whangarei.
